description: This file defines the SimpleValue type for handling CBOR simple values, including encoding and decoding methods, and related constants and error handling.

methods.name: MarshalCBOR
methods.description: Encodes SimpleValue as CBOR simple value (major type 7).

methods.name: UnmarshalCBOR
methods.description: Decodes CBOR simple value (major type 7) into SimpleValue; deprecated, kept for compatibility.

methods.name: unmarshalCBOR
methods.description: Decodes CBOR simple value assuming data is well-formed; called internally by UnmarshalCBOR.
